senses.gloss: f. ch. = h.טוֹבָה , goodness, good deed; profit, enjoyment, pleasure.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 4:8">Targ. Koh. IV, 8</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>חדא ט׳</he> one good deed.
<cite ref="Tamid 32a:51">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>יעביד ט׳ עם וכ׳</he> let him act kindly towards &c.
<cite ref="Taanit 23b:2">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא נחזיק ט׳ וכ׳</he> without having credit given to us.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:16">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="H00554"><he>חֲזַק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Menachot 52a:16">Men. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>מטֵיבוּתָן לא אמרי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מטֵבוּתִין</he>) of our good teachings they do not speak.
<cite ref="Menachot 52a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>הני נמי מטיבותן היא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>טבותין</he>) this is also one of our good things.
